name: cavemio-spinner
title: Spinner
description: Something is happening: a ring with one sweeping arc, three rising dots, or eight petals fading round, in currentColor.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Reduced motion: the ring pulses slowly; dots and petals hold still.
- Use Progress when you know how far along it is.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.
